item.title: Ultracold cesium atoms reveal Bethe strings predicted nearly a century ago
item.description: In 1931, physicist Hans Bethe predicted that, in certain one-dimensional quantum systems, particles can bind together to form multi-particle states known as Bethe strings. For decades, Bethe strings remained primarily a theoretical concept. Fuente: Phys.org.
